content:
jordan (AE): Heads-up: Lumos POC is throwing 502s + occasional 429s during burst tests. Customer paused the demo — they said it spikes under concurrent streams (~120 rps). Need a quick war-room. (customer: lumos-inc, project p123)

maya (SE): On it. Hosted or Dedicated?

jordan (AE): Hosted, model redwood/gpt-13b-v1 (trial). They reproduced it against the /v1/chat/completions endpoint with streaming.

maya (SE): I'm seeing 429s and a 5xx spike in our dashboard for org p123. Can you paste the raw curl they used (include X-Request-Id) and any client-side logs?

jordan (AE): Curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "X-Request-Id: abc123-lumos" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-13b-v1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"generate demo output"}],"stream":true}'
```

infra-bot: alert: 5xx spike detected on region us-east-1 for model redwood/gpt-13b-v1. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/ALRT-8901 :rotating_light:

lee (runtime): Checking runtime. Quick ask: are they using streaming? If yes, KV cache and batch builder pressure can cause 502s when concurrency bursts. Maya, can you grab the runtime + proxy logs and any X-Runtime-Req headers?

maya (SE): Pasting trimmed runtime logs for the window (12:16-12:20):
```
2026-03-12T12:16:22Z runtime[batch-builder]: batch_queue_len=8 -> 200; waiting for workers
2026-03-12T12:16:23Z runtime[kv_cache]: cache_miss for key=user-ctx-98
2026-03-12T12:16:24Z runtime[executor]: exception: timeout waiting for batch completion (500) request_id=abc123-lumos
2026-03-12T12:16:24Z proxy[nginx]: upstream prematurely closed connection (502) while reading response header from upstream, request_id=abc123-lumos
```

samir (oncall): Putting SRE on this. I'll correlate infra metrics and temporarily raise per-org concurrency to avoid immediate customer failure. Jordan, can you ask the customer to retry with the quantized variant redwood/gpt-13b-quant to reduce memory pressure?

olivia (CS): Also note — customer asked about pricing if they switch to quant. They want confirmation this won't change per-token billing mid-POC. Jordan, can you handle that while we triage?

maya (SE): Quant variant uses same billing units (tokens). Quality may differ slightly; we should call it out. Also recommend they implement simple retry/backoff on 429: exponential backoff starting at 100ms, cap 2s, 3 retries. Example: `sleep = 0.1 * (2**attempt)`.

jordan (AE): Sent instructions and asked them to switch to the quant model and restart. Their engineer retried and still sees intermittent 502s. New request ids: abc123-lumos, def456-lumos.

lee (runtime): I see a hotspot in the batch builder: queue length spiked from 8 -> 200 at 12:17:22 which led to worker starvation and a deadlock in the batch flush path. Root cause appears to be the continuous-batching config not honoring per-tenant concurrency caps — batches grew too big and exhausted the executor, leading to timeouts. I'll prepare a hotfix to limit the batch builder to 64 requests per tenant.

samir (oncall): I'll route Lumos org to a canary with the hotfix and increase their concurrency quota temporarily. ETA ~25m to canary and validate. Jordan — let the customer know about a short retry window.

jordan (AE): Customer agreed to a 30m test window. Also flagged: security gating — they requested SOC2 artifact and an NDA contact before procurement can proceed. Olivia, can CS send SOC2 and compliance contact? This is blocking procurement.

olivia (CS): On it. Sent SOC2 link + compliance contact details. Noted procurement timeline ~2 weeks; I'll follow up separately.

lee (runtime): Hotfix pushed to canary at 12:45. infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy commit abcdef -> canary (us-east-1).

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy complete: commit abcdef. Health checks OK.

lee (runtime): Metrics look good — batch queue normalized, CPU & memory stabilized. No new 502s in the last 3m for org p123.

jordan (AE): Demo resumed. Customer reported success and continued the session. Next steps: RCA, postmortem, and recommended default throttle config for POCs. Assigning owners: maya (RCA draft), lee (fix and config), samir (follow up on incident and quota changes). I'll log deal notes and credit adjustments for extra usage.

maya (SE): :thumbsup: I'll draft the RCA and include recommended defaults: per-tenant batch cap=64, default concurrency cap=100 for POCs, and a guideline to use quant models for high concurrency demos. Jordan, please capture POC credits used.

samir (oncall): Closing war-room for now. Incident logged as INC-2026-042. If it flares, reopen this thread or ping me directly.

jordan (AE): Thanks everyone — great response. I'll update the Lumos deal in Salesforce and mark support as involved.
